name: eBay
description: eBay runs online marketplaces where 135 million active buyers shop 2.5 billion live listings from other people and businesses; it owns no inventory. It earns a fee on each sale (final value, listing, feature and payments-related fees, with a take rate of 13.94 percent of gross merchandise volume in 2025) plus advertising that sellers pay to promote listings. 2025 gross merchandise volume was $79.6 billion (+7%), revenue $11.1 billion (+8%) and operating income $2.3 billion. Advertising is the fastest-growing piece (+22 percent). It closed the $1.2 billion Depop acquisition on 2026-07-30.

employees.note: About 12,300 globally, about 7,200 in the US (FY2025 10-K)

businessLines.name: Marketplace
businessLines.how: Sellers pay a percentage of each completed sale plus per-listing and subscription fees; revenue is therefore a take rate on volume that eBay does not own or ship (about 14 cents per dollar of GMV).
businessLines.description: Commissions on sales across eBay marketplace platforms: final value fees, listing and feature fees, store subscriptions, shipping and payments-related fees

businessLines.name: Advertising
businessLines.how: Sellers pay to have their listings placed higher, usually priced per sale or per click, so it grows with seller competition and eBay's on-site traffic.
businessLines.description: Fees sellers pay to promote their listings (first-party advertising), plus third-party advertising

brands.note: Substantially all revenue; Focus Categories include motors parts and accessories, collectibles, refurbished, apparel, luxury and sneakers
